findings.summary: Standardization computes mean/std over the passed DataFrame, leaking test-set statistics into training (build_features called before train_test_split) and producing NaN for single-row inference and inconsistent scaling for small batches; should use a StandardScaler/Pipeline fit on the training split only and saved with the model.
No guard for zero variance: a constant column has std 0, causing division to yield NaN/inf and LogisticRegression.fit to raise on non-finite input; use StandardScaler or replace zero std with 1.
